summary: Round 12 recheck (2026-09-26, ~20:01-20:20 UTC). I picked three closed ideas that no v4 round had touched (checked against round 1 lens_mine-old, the round 2-11 scan_recheck files and the ideas.json sources). I measured all three on local data and changed no repository files. (A) I-034, the 50/50 blend of the public V1284 head with the 199-video head. The recorded verdict has a logic error. v3 s_merge.json l.486, FINAL_REPORT section i and the ledger say 'by convexity the blend is >= +1.6-2% worse on 44b6', but convexity gives an UPPER bound; the v3 schedule skeptic's own text says 'at most'. Embryo-held-out measurement: the blend ties or beats the public head in both directions (6bba->44b6 raw +0.03%, bias-removed -0.67%; 44b6->6bba -1.57% / -1.78%). The corrected reading is a small positive (about +0.0005..+0.0015 by the v3 slope). It stays out of the finals under R4, R8 and the finals rule and goes to the post-deadline list; the ledger text needs fixing. (B) I-147, dropping node groups, re-read for x138's synthetic nodes. On the exp60 lab x138's synthetic nodes are 3-4x less annotated than average (~1% vs 3.63%), but dropping them still loses: gap -0.0024 [-0.0037,-0.0014], all synthetic -0.0027, negative in both embryos. The verdict stands with a corrected reason. (C) I-148, the crop-border rule. Border nodes are ~1% annotated, yet the z-edge drop gives -0.0029 and the xy band <1.6 um gives -0.0132, negative in both embryos. The verdict stands. By-product: the readmitted-leaf drop gives +0.0009 lab (44b6 -0.0006), which repeats the P36 leaf-prune class (lab +0.0008 -> public 0) and is not a new lever. Nothing here affects the finals #37 + #38 or the E10 rule. I submitted, pushed and committed nothing.

findings.what: I-034, the 50/50 blend of the public V1284 head with a 199-video retrained head. OLD VERDICT: refuted. The text in v3 FINAL_REPORT section i, s_merge.json l.486 and l.48, and ledger I-034 reads: 'Debiased Q +3.9% worse on 44b6; by convexity the 50/50 blend is >= +1.6-2% worse there, so gate (b) fails'. The underlying skeptics said something different. v_github-intel_head-blend_schedule.json: 'the blend is AT MOST the average of its two members ... bound is +1.6..2.0%'. The value skeptic: blend^2 <= 0.5(a^2+b^2) - 0.25E|s_pub - s_Q|^2, estimate -1.3% +-1.5%. The merge turned an upper bound into a lower bound. WHAT CHANGED: the public LB is one embryo and the private ~71% is other embryos, so the embryo-held-out direction is the one that matters for private. The heads can be refit in ~30-40 s on CPU from the local captures, so the claim is testable. MEASURED (throwaway heads with the out_full_Q recipe: debias embryo, huber 0.5, 120 epochs; never saved or exported; probable x138 head-train stems excluded; fixed Hungarian pairs <= 4 um; deb = bias-removed sqrt(mean^2 - |bias|^2)): 6bba->44b6 (61 videos): public 1.3006 um; new +5.42% (deb +3.53%); blend50 +0.03% (deb -0.67%); blend25 -0.73% (deb -1.01%); m7 16,820 -> 16,821. 44b6->6bba (118 videos): new +1.38%; blend50 -1.57% (deb -1.78%); blend25 -1.34%; m7 +42. leak5 44b6 blend50 in 4 of 5 folds better (-3.34..+0.73%). NEW VERDICT: the recorded reason is wrong. The blend is NOT worse on 44b6 out-of-embryo: it ties there and is ~1.6-1.8% better on 6bba out-of-embryo. The value is small: the v3 slope of 0.0005-0.001 public per 1% gives ~+0.0005..+0.0015, below R4's +0.002 (~+0.012 lab). It has no x138 metric lab bed (it needs a GPU exp60 rerun with a new headblend patch), no dummy and no user OK before R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC). It therefore stays out of the finals, as a correctly-signed POST-DEADLINE candidate (blend 25-50% with an embryo-robust head). Related correction: I-033's closing reason 'fixes a constant offset the 7 um metric ignores' is contradicted by round 8's measured +0.1 voxel z shift of +0.0016 lab (writer rounding + 7 um boundary). I-033 stays closed on R9 (no retraining).

findings.what: I-147, group-wise node dropping to exploit N_pred. OLD VERDICT (exp39 tail, research/wf_ideas/hyp_nodes-metric.notes.md l.3-8): 'every spatial/length group strongly negative; annotation is spatially uniform; break-even needs P(annotated) < ~0.3%'. WHAT CHANGED: the base is now x138, which adds synthetic nodes. Round 7 found them rarely GT-matched (gap 58/5,647, gap2 29/2,968, readmit 73/13,284), which contradicts 'uniform' and suggests a droppable group. MEASURED (exp60 56 clips, kernel final graphs, official metric via tools/trainlab.official_eval, 300x clip bootstrap 5/95%; control ALL 0.93340; base match 3.63%, 44b6 0.79%, 6bba 5.20%): drop gap_synthetic (0.50% of nodes, 1.03% matched) -0.00242 [-0.00371,-0.00138], dTP -95; 44b6 -0.00857, 6bba -0.00187. gap2 -0.00040 [-0.00081,+0.00003]. gapfill_peak (0.09% of nodes, 0.10% matched) +0.00012 [+0.00003,+0.00027], negligible. All synthetic -0.00270 [-0.00405,-0.00160], negative in both embryos. Readmitted +0.00049 (44b6 -0.00233, 6bba +0.00075). Readmitted leaves +0.00091 [+0.00054,+0.00136] (44b6 -0.00058): the P36 leaf-prune class (lab +0.0008 -> public 0.954 = #35). NEW VERDICT: stays REFUTED, with a corrected reason. Annotation is not uniform (synthetic nodes are 3-4x less annotated than average), but still far above the ~0.16-0.3% break-even (round 11 metric re-audit), because each annotated gap node costs ~2 TP edges. The readmit sub-arm only re-measures the P36 class, which did not transfer.

findings.what: I-148, the spatial crop-border rule (drop or discount nodes at the volume border). OLD VERDICT (research/wf_ideas_v2/r2_critic.json; ledger): 'measured dead end, border ceiling +0.0012 confounded'. The exp39 node table measured bxy<2um at -0.045. WHAT CHANGED: the x138 base (head-refined coordinates, readmit/gapfill). The public/private split raised the question of whether border annotation is sparse enough to make border nodes 'free' bonus nodes. The DoG verdict also noted misses enriched at z<=3 and at xy borders. MEASURED (same exp60 bed and method as R12-RC-B): z-edge slices (z rounded to 0 or zmax; 1.56% of nodes, 0.90% matched): -0.00285 [-0.00461,-0.00136], dTP -150; 44b6 -0.00655, 6bba -0.00252. xy band < 4 px (1.6 um; 6.42% of nodes, 1.27% matched): -0.01318 [-0.01624,-0.01010], dTP -862, W/L 13/43; 44b6 -0.00413, 6bba -0.01399. NEW VERDICT: stays REFUTED, now measured on x138 in both embryos. Border nodes are ~3x less annotated than the base, but ~1% is 3-8x above break-even. No border discount or drop rule is worth building, before or after the deadline.

findings.what: The exp60 x138 lab annotation density per predicted node is very uneven: 3.63% pooled, 0.79% on 44b6 (17 clips), 5.20% on 6bba (39 clips), and single clips as low as 0.14% (44b6_18ced818: 100 of 73,152). Any node-count lever therefore flips sign by embryo (readmitted-node drop: 44b6 -0.0023 vs 6bba +0.0008), and pooled lab deltas for node levers mostly reflect the 6bba mix. This supports the earlier finding that node-count levers show lab gains that do not reach the LB (P36, the edge filter).
